name: Rokugou Sayaka
source:
A gentle, pure, and mild-mannered young woman. After graduating from university, she married Tatsuhi, her boyfriend from their student days, and became a full-time housewife without ever entering the workforce. 

As a result, she has little real-world social experience. She is devoted to her husband and has no sexual experience with anyone else.
